objectives.en: Say every fact from eight times one to eight times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti eight times one dé eight times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from eight times one reach eight times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any eight times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí eight times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any eight times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of eight mangoes. Today we count in eights.
say.pcm: Look three groups of eight mango. Today we go count eight eight.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti eight mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní eight eight.

say.en: Today you will learn the eight times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table eight. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table eight. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the seven times table? What is seven times four?
say.pcm: You remember table seven? Seven times four na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table seven? Kí ni seven times four?

say.en: Three groups of eight mangoes show this. We count eight, sixteen, twenty-four. Eight times three is twenty-four.
say.pcm: See three groups of eight mango: eight, sixteen, twenty-four. Eight times three na twenty-four.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti eight mango: eight, sixteen, twenty-four. Eight times three jẹ́ twenty-four.

say.en: Say it with me: eight times three is twenty-four.
say.pcm: Say am with me: eight times three na twenty-four.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: eight times three jẹ́ twenty-four.

say.en: Say the eight times table. Start with eight times one. End with eight times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table eight. Start with eight times one. End with eight times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table eight. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú eight times one. Parí pẹ̀lú eight times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Eight times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the eight times table once more. Then we start the nine times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table eight again. Then we start table nine.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table eight. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table nine.
